scytale.name: Scytale
scytale.desc: A strip of jumbled letters: wind it on a rod of the right thickness to read it

field.phraseHint: What the players will read. Spaces and punctuation are removed.
field.facesTip: The rod's thickness is the key: 3 to 12 faces. Leave empty to pick one by phrase length.

problem.empty: Type a phrase: the strip is built from it.
problem.tooLong: Too long: {letters}, but the strip holds at most {max}. Shorten the phrase.

tailNote.one: The last letter is a filler.

preview.right: Rod with {faces}: the phrase reads along the faces
preview.wrong: Rod with {faces}: gibberish along the faces

view.windTip: Wind the strip on your rod with {faces}
view.windAria: The strip wound on a rod
